notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oscwwjm.jpg[/img]

[b]The new patch 1.0.5.1 is now live for Front Page Sports Football![/b]
Amongst other things, the english localisation have been reworked, and there is a brand new injuries system.
We also fixed the problems related to 3D games display when using an Intel HD 4000 card.

Full changelog available at:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/316700/discussions/0/619573787621889766/

tags.feature: and there is a brand new injuries system.

tags.bug: We also fixed the problems related to 3D games display when using an Intel HD 4000 card.

notes.title: NEW: Customize your Database!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MK64Hym.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Front Page Sports Football now includes a Database Editor!![/b] Every team and player can be changed, so you can play in your own special way! 

[b]Along with this enhancement, a new patch has been released[/b]: 
- Redesign of the style of a few pages
- Fixed the number of yards traveled in the games comments
- Fixed some minor bugs, texts, crashes ...

tags.feature: - Redesign of the style of a few pages

tags.bug: - Fixed the number of yards traveled in the games comments
- Fixed some minor bugs, texts, crashes ...

notes.title: First Patch available!
notes.content:
[b]The first patch for Front Page Sports Football is now live![/b]

4th down conversions are now possible and you can now choose between many camera options in the 3D games. We also fixed some errors concerning rules or translations, and bugs.

[b]The complete changelog is available here:[/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/app/316700/discussions/0/613938693119319421/

tags.feature: you can now choose between many camera options in the 3D games

tags.bug: We also fixed some errors concerning rules or translations, and bugs.
